Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
TAPER PIN HAND REAMERS 

(First Revision) 



(Reaffirmed 2004) 






1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and requirements for hand reamers used for producing tapered 
holes for taper pins conforming to IS : 6688-1972 'Specification for taper pins*. 

2. Types — Shall be of following types : 

Type A — Straight flutes, and 

Type B — Spiral flutes with left hand spiral. 

3. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

3.1 The taper on taper pin reamers shall be 1 : 50. The cone angle tolerance shall be AT8 as per 
IS : 7615-1975 'System of cone tolerances'. 

4. Tolerances -- Tolerance on cutting length A and overal length / shall be as given below: 



Cutting Length /i and 
Overall Length/

Tolerance

±3-0 



5. General Requirements 

5.1 Reamers up to 6 mm nominal diameter shall be supplied with male centre at one end. 

5.2 For requirements not covered in this standard, it shall conform to the requirements given in 
IS : 5443-1984 'Technical supply conditions for reamers ( first revision )'. 

6. Sampling — The sampling and criteria of acceptance shall be in accordance with 18:7778-1975 
'Methods for sampling small tools'. 

7. Designation — A taper pin, hand reamer of Type A, having diameter rf = 6 mm, made from high 
speed steel and conforming to this standard shall be designated as: 

Reamer A 6 IS : 5881 

8. ISr Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



Adopted 27 January 1984

Note 2

IS :5881 - 1984 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was first published in 1970 and has been revised to bring it in line with the work 
done at ISO level. In this revision Type B reamers with left hand spiral have been included. 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from the following 
standards: 

ISO 3465-1975 'Hand taper pin reamers'. International Organization for Standardization (ISO). 

DIN 9-1975 'Hand-kegelrcibahlen fur Kegelstiftbakrungen' (Hand taper pin reamers for taper pin 
boles). Deutches Institut fiir Normung { DIN ). 

All the dimensions given in ISO 3465-1975 have been included in this standard. Further 
dimensions of the shank portion have been added according to DIN 9-1975. The surface roughness 
of the cutting portion is also specified. 

Taper pin hand reamers were earlier covered in IS : 1836-1961 'Specification for reamers'. This 
standard apart from covering the taper pin hand reamers, also covered the dimensions and requirements 
for various types of reamers. In 1969, it was decided to withdraw IS : 1836 and issue a series of 
standards covering various types of reamers and techninal supply conditions in separate standards. 
This standard is one of the standards of that series. 

Other related standards: 

a) IS : 10851-1984 Taper pin machine reamers with parallel shanks. 

b) IS : 591 8-1984 Taper pin machine reamers with morse taper shanks ( first revision ), 



Printed at Printrade, New Delhi, India
